milestones.title: Sprint 1 - Systems and sync
milestones.description: Goal: a closed-won deal in the CRM becomes exactly one posted invoice in the ERP, through tested connectors, on a local stack that bootstraps itself with least-privilege integration users.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 - Reconciliation and tickets
milestones.description: Goal: a reconciliation run finds every seeded mismatch between CRM and ERP, measured with precision and recall per class, and files one deduplicated helpdesk ticket per exception.

milestones.title: Sprint 3 - Workflows and triage
milestones.description: Goal: n8n drives the sync, the nightly reconciliation and an approval step; a LlamaIndex triage agent routes billing messages, measured on held-out labelled data against a classical baseline.

milestones.title: Sprint 4 - Observability and release
milestones.description: Goal: every triage turn is a Langfuse trace, the hub has metrics, a dashboard and tested alerts, the measured results are committed and the release is documented.

milestones.title: Backlog
milestones.description: Work that needs an account only the owner can create (labelled blocked:account).

issues.title: Scaffold, settings from the environment, JSON logs and CI
issues.body:
As a contributor, I want one command for setup and a CI that lints, type-checks and tests every push.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] uv project, ruff, mypy and pytest with coverage in CI
- [ ] settings validated from environment variables; `.env.example` with no secrets; `make env` generates local secrets
- [ ] gitleaks before every push and in CI; pip-audit in CI

issues.title: Local stack: Postgres, Odoo 19 and EspoCRM 10 with least-privilege integration users
issues.body:
As a finance-ops engineer, I want the ERP and the CRM running locally with one command, so I can build and test the integration without vendor accounts.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] `make up` starts Postgres, Odoo (CRM, Sales, Invoicing; no demo data) and EspoCRM, all healthy
- [ ] Odoo integration user limited to sales and invoicing groups, signed in by API key
- [ ] EspoCRM API user with a role scoped to Account and Opportunity, plus the custom fields the sync writes back
- [ ] keys written to a git-ignored folder, never printed

issues.title: Spike: can Odoo's JSON-2 API and EspoCRM's API users be driven headless?
issues.body:
Time-boxed: decide the ERP and CRM for the local stack.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Odoo 19 Community serves /json/2 with a bearer API key created from `odoo shell`
- [ ] EspoCRM creates an API user and a webhook through its REST API
- [ ] ADR with the decision and the alternatives (Twenty, ERPNext, two Odoo databases)

issues.title: Connectors for EspoCRM, Odoo and Salesforce
issues.body:
As the integration hub, I want one interface per system role (CRM source, ERP sink) with adapters behind it, so the sync does not care which CRM it reads.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Odoo JSON-2 client: retries on 429/5xx and timeouts with backoff, typed errors, never retries a create blindly
- [ ] EspoCRM client: paged reads with a modified-since cursor, write-back of ERP ids
- [ ] Salesforce client (OAuth 2.0 client credentials, SOQL paging, sObject update) tested against a local stub of the documented REST responses
- [ ] integration tests against the real Odoo and EspoCRM containers

issues.title: Seeded order-to-cash data generator
issues.body:
As a tester, I want a reproducible CRM book of business (accounts, deals in three currencies, seat-based plans) so every run is comparable.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] same seed, same data; loads into EspoCRM through its API
- [ ] pricing rules in one place, shared by generator and sync

issues.title: Deal-to-invoice sync, exactly once across reruns and crashes
issues.body:
As a controller, I want every closed-won deal invoiced once, with the right customer, currency and amount.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] customer matched or created by CRM id, then by normalised domain; no duplicates
- [ ] invoice carries the CRM deal id; a rerun creates nothing new
- [ ] a crash between ERP write and checkpoint does not double-invoice (test kills the run mid-batch)
- [ ] failures retried with backoff, then dead-lettered with the reason; dead letters can be replayed

issues.title: Reconciliation of CRM deals against ERP invoices and payments
issues.body:
As a controller, I want a report that proves both systems agree, or lists every disagreement with its class.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] classes: missing invoice, amount mismatch, currency mismatch, orphan invoice, duplicate customer, cancelled invoice on a won deal, billing-status drift
- [ ] a fault injector edits both systems at known rates and writes the ground truth
- [ ] precision and recall per class from a committed run

issues.title: Zammad helpdesk; each exception is one ticket, deduplicated and closed when fixed
issues.body:
As finance ops, I want reconciliation exceptions in our helpdesk queue, not in a spreadsheet.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Zammad in the stack (Elasticsearch disabled, ADR), groups and an API token from a bootstrap
- [ ] one ticket per exception fingerprint; reruns add nothing; resolved exceptions close their ticket with a note
- [ ] integration test against the real Zammad container

issues.title: GitHub Issues and Jira ticket adapters with contract tests
issues.body:
As a team on GitHub or Jira, I want the same exceptions filed where we already work.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] same TicketSink interface; label/JQL search for the fingerprint before creating
- [ ] contract tests against recorded response shapes from the vendors' API docs

issues.title: Signed CRM webhooks and payment status written back to the CRM
issues.body:
As an account manager, I want to see in the CRM whether the deal was invoiced and paid.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] webhook endpoint verifies EspoCRM's HMAC signature and rejects replays and unsigned calls
- [ ] invoice id and billing status (invoiced, paid, overdue) written back to the deal

issues.title: n8n workflows for the sync, the nightly reconciliation and refund approval, tested in CI
issues.body:
As finance ops, I want the schedules, notifications and approvals in a workflow tool we can read, and the business logic in tested code.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] workflows exported as JSON in the repo and imported by the stack on start
- [ ] CI imports them into a real n8n, fires each webhook path and checks the outcome
- [ ] run counts and durations from a measured run

issues.title: Triage agent on LlamaIndex for billing and support messages
issues.body:
As a support lead, I want inbound messages categorised, routed to the right queue with a cited draft reply, and refunds over a threshold held for approval.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] LlamaIndex over pgvector (knowledge base and labelled past messages), local model through Ollama
- [ ] tools: invoice lookup in the ERP (read-only), ticket creation; prompt-injected instructions in a message cannot call other tools
- [ ] structured output validated; refunds over the threshold go to approval, never auto-approved

issues.title: Triage evaluation on held-out labelled messages against a classical baseline
issues.body:
As the owner of the agent, I want to know whether it beats a cheap baseline before anyone relies on it.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] public labelled dataset with a licence that allows it; split fixed by seed
- [ ] TF-IDF + logistic regression baseline, zero-shot LLM, retrieval few-shot agent: accuracy and macro-F1 with confidence intervals
- [ ] model card with data, metrics and limits

issues.title: Self-hosted Langfuse with a trace per triage turn
issues.body:
As the owner of the agent, I want every turn traced with its prompt, retrieval, tool calls, tokens and latency.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Langfuse (web, worker, ClickHouse, Redis, MinIO) in the stack with a headless project and keys
- [ ] OpenInference instrumentation of LlamaIndex exporting OTLP to Langfuse
- [ ] tokens and latency per turn read back from Langfuse's API for a committed run

issues.title: Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboard and tested alert rules
issues.body:
As on-call, I want to know when the sync stops, dead letters pile up or exceptions spike.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] /metrics on the hub; health and readiness endpoints
- [ ] alert rules with promtool unit tests; a provisioned Grafana dashboard

issues.title: Throughput and an end-to-end run on the full seeded data, measured
issues.body:
As the owner, I want measured numbers, not estimates, in the README.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] sync throughput and latency against the real Odoo on one machine, hardware stated
- [ ] every README number traced to a committed report file

issues.title: Terraform for an OCI Always Free VM, validated in CI
issues.body:
As the owner, I want the stack deployable to a free cloud VM when I have the account.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] Terraform for an Always Free ARM VM with cloud-init running the compose stack
- [ ] fmt, validate, tflint and trivy in CI; not applied (needs the owner's account)

issues.title: README, architecture, ADRs, runbook and release v1.0.0
issues.body:
As a hiring manager, I want to understand the problem, the design and the measured results in two minutes.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] README with problem, architecture diagram, how to run, results and limitations
- [ ] runbook for each alert; deploy guide for the accounts

issues.title: Live sync against a Salesforce Developer Edition org
issues.body:
Needs the owner's Salesforce Developer Edition org and an External Client App (client credentials).

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] custom fields deployed from `salesforce/`
- [ ] the contract tests' recorded shapes confirmed against the live org
- [ ] the measured sync run repeated with HUB_CRM=salesforce

issues.title: Live ticket filing into a Jira Cloud Free project
issues.body:
Needs the owner's Jira Cloud Free site and an API token.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] reconciliation exceptions filed and deduplicated in a Jira project with HUB_TICKETS=jira
